title: Affine free cochain complex cancellation from a supplied unit coefficient
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $P$ a cochain complex [def-pc-derived-category] of $\mathcal O_S$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $n:\mathbf Z\to\mathbf N$ and choose free-sheaf identifications $e_j:P^j\cong\mathcal O_S^{n(j)}$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Fix $i\in\mathbf Z$, a basis index $p$ in degree $i$, and a basis index $q$ in degree $i+1$. Suppose the $(q,p)$ coefficient of $e_{i+1}d^ie_i^{-1}$ is a unit of $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$. There exists a cochain complex $P\prime$ homotopy equivalent to $P$ whose terms are free of sizes $n(j)-1$ when $j=i$ or $j=i+1$, and of sizes $n(j)$ otherwise. Moreover $P\prime{}^j\cong P^j$ for every $j\ne i,i+1$. No support bounds, local-ring assumption, residue map or nonzero residue differential is assumed.

source.place: Tag 00MT (lemma-add-trivial-complex), splitting and its contracting identity summand; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00MT

proof.text: Lift P and the unit entry by [lem-pc-affine-free-complex-module-lift]. This produces C,m,b,p′,q′ and differential-compatible sheaf comparisons, before any cancellation.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-free-complex-unit-entry-splits] at -i, then contract the supplied T summand by [lem-pc-split-identity-homotopy-equiv]. The remaining complex C′ has bases indexed by m′. The two equations m′(-i)+1=m(-i) and m′(-i-1)+1=m(-i-1), and equality of all other sizes, give the required rank formula by natural-number arithmetic.

Map the module homotopy equivalence through the additive tilde functor and reverse degree j to -j. Reverse the chain maps and homotopy components explicitly; the homotopy equation follows from the chain equation by -(j+1)=-j-1 and -(j-1)=-j+1. The original sheaf comparisons assemble into an isomorphism of complexes. Compose its inverse homotopy equivalence with the transported equivalence. Reindex the bases of C′ by ULift and apply tildeFinsupp to identify each sheaf term with the required free sheaf. In each unaffected degree this size is n(j), so compose that free-sheaf isomorphism with e_j^{-1} to identify it with P^j.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00MT, with the affine comparison of Tags 01HV and 01I7; Lean reduction via explicit contraction and grading reversal

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_free_complex_unit_cancellation (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (Spec R).Modules ℤ) (n : ℤ → ℕ)
    (e : ∀ j : ℤ, P.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n j))))
    (i : ℤ) (p : ULift.{u} (Fin (n i))) (q : ULift.{u} (Fin (n (i + 1))))
    (hunit : IsUnit (freeMatrix ((e i).inv ≫ P.d i (i + 1) ≫ (e (i + 1)).hom) q p)) :
    ∃ P' : CochainComplex (Spec R).Modules ℤ,
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv P P') ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (P'.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
        (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin (if j = i ∨ j = i + 1 then n j - 1 else n j))))) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ i → j ≠ i + 1 → Nonempty (P'.X j ≅ P.X j))
